body:
Fix pass for the three Important findings of the final review:

1. Empty finding set (a filter that matched nothing) crashed ConvertTo-HygieneHtml and Export-HygieneFinding. Now HTML renders, CSV is header-only, JSON is [].
2. Graph users with no sign-in and no creation date read as clean in M365-02/M365-05. Now reported as stale ("No activity and no creation date recorded.").
3. The read-only guard was case-sensitive (Set-AdUser passed). Now case-insensitive.

Each fix has a test that failed first (8 RED, then GREEN). Locally: Pester 90/90, PSScriptAnalyzer 0 on Windows PowerShell 5.1. Example report unchanged.
